name: Action bar
purpose: A footer bar that pins a screen or flow's primary + secondary actions (e.g. Cancel / Confirm payment). A layout container that composes the Button atom — the bar itself is passive; its buttons carry the interaction. Surfaced as a missing pattern by the journey gap report.

props.name: sticky
props.$note: Pin the bar to the bottom of a scrolling flow (position:sticky).

props.name: actions
props.$note: 1–3 actions: one primary + optional secondary + optional tertiary (e.g. Back). More than 3 is an anti-pattern.

variants.name: default
variants.use: Tertiary Back on the left + secondary/primary pair on the right (wide container).

variants.name: sticky
variants.use: Same bar pinned to the bottom of a scrolling region.

commonPatterns: Back + Cancel + Confirm in a flow step
Back + Continue in a multi-step flow

motion.buttons: Button scale-physics — grow toward the cursor on hover (transform:scale, --spring) + depress and darken on press (--press); SCALE only, no shadow/translate.
motion.reducedMotion: transforms + filter disabled under prefers-reduced-motion (colour states remain).

responsive.unit: container width (container-type:inline-size on the bar's region — reflows to its own width, not the viewport)
responsive.wide: inline — tertiary Back pinned left (margin-right:auto), secondary + primary on the right
responsive.narrow: stacked, each button full-width; PRIMARY promoted to the TOP, tertiary Back to the BOTTOM (mobile priority); hover-grow disabled (a full-bleed grow overflows)

behaviour: Passive layout container — no states of its own; the Button atom inside carries hover/pressed/focus.

accessibility.role: None on the bar itself (it is layout); the actions are native <button>s so they are focusable and keyboard-operable by default.
accessibility.focusOrder: REVIEW (inferred): DOM order is tertiary→secondary→primary (Back → Cancel → Confirm) so keyboard focus runs back-out → forward; the visual reorder at narrow widths (primary top, Back bottom) is CSS order only — confirm this does not conflict with 2.4.3 expectations.

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): more than ~3 actions in the bar — overflow secondary actions into a menu instead.
REVIEW (inferred): two competing primary (red) buttons — exactly one primary per bar.
REVIEW (inferred): giving Back a filled (primary/secondary) treatment — it is the lowest-emphasis action (tertiary/outlined).
REVIEW (inferred): rounding the buttons or the bar — brand is square/angular.
REVIEW (inferred): relying on the CSS reorder while leaving DOM order such that keyboard focus reaches Confirm before Cancel — keep DOM order logical (2.4.3).

tokenValidation.against: canon token store (semantic-colour.json); declared values match in light + dark (passes _validate_snippets); button tokens reused verbatim from Button.

provenance.$note: REVIEW: no Figma node yet — surfaced by the journey gap report (the .c-actionbar hand-util) and Button.meta commonPatterns. Needs a design owner + Figma source before promotion from candidate to gated.
